bioconda.name: autocycler
bioconda.summary: A tool for generating consensus long-read assemblies for bacterial genomes.

biotools.summary: Autocycler is a command-line tool that generates accurate bacterial genome assemblies by combining multiple long-read assemblies. It builds a compacted De Bruijn graph and resolves consensus sequences, supporting manual curation when needed.
